title: Implement late-join DAG backfill via parent-link traversal
description:
Implement backfill(want_cid: Cid, storage: &dyn LogStorage, fetch: impl Fn(Cid) -> Result<LogEntry>) -> Result<()>: fetch the entry for want_cid, recursively fetch all parent_cids not already in local storage, persist each. Artifact: src/group_log/backfill.rs.

Acceptance:
- backfill() fetches all ancestors not already local
- backfill() is idempotent (already-local entries are skipped, not re-fetched)
- backfill() handles diamond-shaped DAGs without duplicate fetches
- backfill() returns error if fetch callback fails (caller retries)
- Unit test: backfill a 100-entry chain from a fresh replica
